claims.text: Many reviewers report visible firming and smoothing results on their neck and chin, often noticing improvement quickly.
Some reviewers say the cream made no noticeable difference in firming, even after finishing a full jar.
Reviewers frequently describe the cream as rich, nourishing, and pleasant-feeling on the skin.
A few reviewers note drawbacks such as sun sensitivity warnings or the product being inferior to a pricier alternative.
